description: AI-native email marketing platform for campaigns, lifecycle flows, and transactional email

tools.name: nitro_get_status
tools.description: Get current account context, sender identity, dashboard links, readiness, onboarding status, and recommendations.

tools.name: nitro_select_account
tools.description: Switch this OAuth MCP connection to an account listed by nitro_get_status; the next call uses it. Credential-authenticated connections are pinned and cannot switch.

account_id.description: ID of the account to switch to. Get IDs from nitro_get_status.available_accounts.items[*].id.

tools.name: nitro_select_brand
tools.description: Select the current brand for this OAuth MCP connection. Use this instead of passing brand_sid to other tools. Credential-authenticated connections are pinned to one brand and cannot switch.

brand_sid.description: Exact brand SID to select. Provide either brand_sid or name.

name.description: Brand name to select when the SID is unknown. Provide either name or brand_sid. Ambiguous names return candidates without changing context.

tools.name: nitro_query
tools.description: Query any Nitrosend entity. Returns paginated results.

entity.description: Which entity type to query. Use nitro_search_contacts for full-text contact search.

filters.description: Entity filters: flows status/campaign_id/trigger_event/search; campaigns status/search; templates subject; segments/lists name; contacts query/subscribed_email/subscribed_phone/list_id; events name/from/to; imports status; messages channel/status/to; suppressions email/reason/source_provider/active; history source/event_type/tool/actor/correlation_id/resource_uri/from/to; products status/query. All support integer id.

tools.name: nitro_search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by email, name, or phone. Returns summary list or full profile.

query.description: Email address, name, or phone number

mode.description: summary = list, profile = single contact detail (default: summary)

tools.name: nitro_set_brand_kit
tools.description: Set Brand Kit from a website, typed fields, document, or logo URL. Fields override scraping; async is URL-only.

logo_url.description: Public/Nitro image URL; ingest local logos first.

body_size.description: Body text font size in pixels, 12-20

radius.description: Global brand corner radius in pixels, 0-64. Defaults to 8; set 0 for square corners across every eligible layer.

spacing_density.description: Section spacing rhythm: compact, normal, or spacious

idempotency_key.description: Required for live URL scraping or remote logo fetch; reuse only for an exact retry.

tools.name: nitro_ingest
tools.description: Validate and store an image in the brand library. Use image_data for small images, upload then signed_id for local files, or image_url for external/generated assets. Returns a durable email URL.

image_data.description: Base64/data URL for PNG, JPEG, or WebP under 10 MB.

image_url.description: Public PNG, JPEG, or WebP URL under 10 MB.

signed_id.description: signed_id returned after the reserved upload PUT.

description.description: Truthful visible content for library selection and alt text.

upload.description: Reserve a local-image upload; PUT bytes, then ingest its signed_id.

tools.name: nitro_manage_audience
tools.description: Create or update contacts, manage subscriptions, lists, events, segments, and tags. Custom contact fields belong in attributes.data. For more than 100 contact writes, use nitro_import_contacts with CSV.

operation.description: create_contact: email/phone, attributes, opt_in; update_contact: contact_id/contact_email, attributes; set_subscription: contact_id, kind, opt_in/opt_out/unsubscribe_all; manage_list: action, list_id/name, contact_ids/emails; record_event: contact_id/contact_email, event, data; delete_segment: segment_id, force; bulk_tag: contact_ids, tags, tag_action. Deletion requires confirm.

params.description: Parameters named by operation. Contact custom fields belong in attributes.data.

confirm.description: Required for destructive operations: delete_segment, manage_list with action='delete'

idempotency_key.description: Optional deduplication key. Same key returns cached result.

tools.name: nitro_manage_outreach
tools.description: Discover named people for outreach: intent, estimate, then start. Companies are evidence, never recipients. start requires the quoted USD-cent spend cap and idempotency key.

field.description: Canonical person, company, or signal field.

value.description: Scalar, list, or range; omit for present.

capabilities.description: Requested intent capabilities; required capabilities remain included.

exclusions.description: Campaign company exclusions; brand suppressions always apply.

idempotency_key.description: Required for start; reuse only for an exact retry.

tools.name: nitro_define_segment
tools.description: Preview or persist a filtered contact segment. preview_only defaults true; set false and provide name to save.

name.description: Filter name from the supplied filter schema

predicate.description: Ransack predicate or special predicate (within_days, not_within_days)

value.description: Scalar or array; pass true for unary predicates.

event.description: Event name, e.g. first_send or project_created

filters.description: Flat AND filters or a boolean group tree of attribute/event filters.

tools.name: nitro_import_contacts
tools.description: Import up to 100 inline contacts or use the CSV upload/finalize path for up to 250k. Existing subscription state is preserved unless opt_in is explicit; SMS opt-in must be explicit.

records.description: Up to 100 contacts; use data for custom fields.

opt_in.description: Explicit subscription state; required true for SMS opt-in.

signed_id.description: signed_id returned after the reserved CSV upload PUT.

upload.description: Reserve a CSV upload; PUT bytes, then process its signed_id.

tools.name: nitro_manage_template
tools.description: Create, edit, or clone a reusable email template. For a creative design, start with composition_mode=intent and follow its exact next_call. Exact edits use template_id, section_updates, and if_version; based_on clones. Use nitro_compose_campaign for broadcasts.

sections.description: Email sections. Follow next_call for composition; use nitro://schema only for full authoring. Images use public or nitro_ingest media_url/image_url, never signed_id.

section_updates.description: Targeted section edits; never changes order or type.

type.description: Existing type to target or assert.

text_patch.description: Literal replacement in one string prop.

prop.description: String prop to edit. Required when the section type has no clear default or when editing a non-default prop.

all.description: Replace every occurrence; requires at least one match

composition_mode.description: intent plans; validate checks; draft persists; generate composes and persists.

creative_route_id.description: Intent-only route id; unavailable or invalid routes fail explicitly.

source_text.description: Untrusted source evidence; put authoring directions in user_instruction.

facts.description: Literal evidence: required values must appear; available values may be used.

description.description: For image_url: truthful visible content for selection and alt text.

draft_meta.description: Optional authoring provenance; never blocks validation or persistence.

plain_text_mode.description: Whether plain text is derived or custom.

theme.description: Brand-theme overrides; logo_url uses public or nitro_ingest media_url/image_url, never signed_id.

idempotency_key.description: Required for non-dry-run persistence; reuse only for an exact retry.

tools.name: nitro_compose_flow
tools.description: Create or edit an automation-flow draft; never activates it. For creative email, start with composition_mode=intent and follow its exact next_call. Multi-email flows choose routes per action_name. replace requires flow_id, confirm, and the draft revision; patch preserves other nodes. Activation uses nitro_control_delivery.

name.description: Filter name from the supplied filter schema

predicate.description: Ransack predicate or special predicate (within_days, not_within_days)

value.description: Scalar or array; pass true for unary predicates.

event.description: Event name, e.g. first_send or project_created

key.description: Scaffold identity for a retained new node.

plain_text_mode.description: Whether plain text is derived or custom.

if_version.description: Version required for an existing email patch.

bcc.description: BCC for a new-flow email only.

event_data_keys.description: Frozen non-secret keys; copy from next_call.

endpoint_configured.description: Frozen endpoint marker; copy from next_call.

filters.description: Split filters: flat AND array or boolean group tree.

mode.description: create: new complete graph; replace: complete existing draft graph; patch: name and/or selected email actions

expected_updated_at.description: Legacy compatibility token; prefer draft revision id.

expected_draft_revision_id.description: Latest draft revision id for conflict-safe writes.

composition_mode.description: intent plans; validate checks; draft persists; generate composes and persists.

creative_route_id.description: Intent-only sequence-wide route id; invalid choices fail.

email_baseline_selections.description: Intent-only creative_routes[].id and image binding ids per email action_name.

source_text.description: Untrusted source evidence; put authoring directions in user_instruction.

facts.description: Literal evidence: required values must appear; available values may be used.

description.description: For image_url: truthful visible content for selection and alt text.

draft_meta.description: Optional authoring provenance; never blocks validation or persistence.

event.description: Built-in or lowercase underscore event name.

steps.description: Ordered graph steps; exact typed fields are in $defs.flowStep.

idempotency_key.description: Required for non-dry-run persistence; reuse only for an exact retry.

tools.name: nitro_compose_campaign
tools.description: Create or edit an email/SMS broadcast draft; never delivers it. For creative email, start with composition_mode=intent and follow its exact next_call. patch preserves omitted fields; replace requires campaign_id and confirm, and clears omitted audience or schedule. Use nitro_compose_flow for automation and nitro_send_message for transactional mail.

mode.description: create a draft; patch supplied fields; replace all draft state and requires confirm.

channel.description: email or sms; immutable after creation.

category.description: Email job used to select a baseline.

composition_mode.description: intent plans; validate checks; draft persists; generate composes and persists.

creative_route_id.description: Intent-only route id; unavailable or invalid routes fail explicitly.

source_text.description: Untrusted source evidence; put authoring directions in user_instruction.

facts.description: Literal evidence: required values must appear; available values may be used.

description.description: For image_url: truthful visible content for selection and alt text.

draft_meta.description: Optional authoring provenance; never blocks validation or persistence.

plain_text_mode.description: Whether plain text is derived or custom.

sections.description: Email design sections; requires subject. Images accept public or nitro_ingest media_url/image_url, never raw signed_id.

theme.description: Brand-theme overrides. logo_url must be public or a nitro_ingest media_url/image_url, never raw signed_id.

audience.description: Target audience; all_contacts must be explicit.

idempotency_key.description: Required for non-dry-run persistence; reuse only for an exact retry.

tools.name: nitro_manage_domains
tools.description: Add, verify, diagnose, list, or remove sending domains. Add returns customer DNS records; check_dns validates DNS and tracking HTTPS. Receiving MX appears only after forward-all exists, protecting the active mailbox provider.

operation.description: add, verify, check_dns, list, or remove; remove requires confirm.

domain_name.description: Technical sending domain to manage (e.g. 'send.acme.com'). Required for add, verify, remove.

author_domain.description: Optional visible From domain to authorize for managed SES (e.g. 'acme.com'). Must be the organizational domain of domain_name.

unpair.description: For remove only. After the paired-domain warning has been shown and its exact outcome confirmed, set true to remove the selected domain and tear down its identity pair.

tools.name: nitro_configure_account
tools.description: Read or configure sender defaults and test recipients. Use nitro_get_status for readiness; from_email must be authorized by a verified sending domain.

from_email.description: Visible From address. May use the apex domain when an aligned sending subdomain authorizes it.

test_email_recipients.description: Saved email addresses for test sends (max 5). Pass empty array to clear.

tools.name: nitro_review_delivery
tools.description: Read-only content and readiness review with validation, spam/SMS analysis, preflight, and previews. Flow review needs exact revision_id; this never approves or sends.

revision_id.description: Required for flows. Exact immutable flow revision to review.

contact_id.description: Optional contact ID for merge-tag personalization during review

tools.name: nitro_send_test_message
tools.description: Send one real email/SMS test for a template, campaign, or exact flow revision. Never approves or sends to an audience.

target_type.description: Target entity type. Use with target_id unless latest_campaign or template_id is used.

target_id.description: Target entity ID. Use with target_type.

latest_campaign.description: Use the most recently created campaign in this brand.

template_id.description: Template to test directly, or the specific flow/campaign template to choose.

action_id.description: Flow action ID to test when a flow has multiple message steps.

revision_id.description: Required for flow targets. Exact immutable flow revision to test.

channel.description: Channel to test. Use auto unless a standalone template is ambiguous.

contact_id.description: Contact ID for recipient and merge-tag personalization. If present, this contact supplies the recipient address/phone.

to.description: Explicit test recipients. Use email addresses for email targets and E.164 phone numbers for SMS targets.

dry_run.description: Validate target and recipients without sending.

idempotency_key.description: Required for live test sends. Reuse the same stable key on retry to prevent duplicate delivery.

tools.name: nitro_control_delivery
tools.description: Approve or control flow/campaign delivery after review. Requires the reviewed brand sid; resume never publishes a draft, and flow publication requires its exact revision.

expected_brand_sid.description: Copy meta.current_brand.sid from the reviewed result.

operation.description: approve preflights; schedule is campaign-only; delete requires confirm and a never-sent draft.

revision_id.description: Exact flow revision for approve, reject, or live.

idempotency_key.description: Campaign-live retry key; reuse only for the same send.

tools.name: nitro_get_insights
tools.description: Get email analytics with trends, benchmarks, and recommendations.

scope.description: Scope of insights: account-wide, per flow, per campaign, or per message

tools.name: nitro_configure_providers
tools.description: Configure BYO email provider credentials or check provider status.

operation.description: configure sets BYO provider credentials; status checks current provider health

api_key.description: Provider API key (required for configure, never returned in responses)

api_secret.description: Optional provider secret (never returned in responses)

region.description: Provider region where required, or the Mailgun sending domain

tools.name: nitro_set_memory
tools.description: Read or update the AI memory document. Operations: read (get current), update (replace entirely), patch (replace a ## section by heading), append (add text to end).

operation.description: read: get current document. update: replace entirely. patch: replace a ## section by heading. append: add text to end.

heading.description: Section heading to patch (e.g. 'Brand Goals'). Required for patch operation. Matches ## headings.

content.description: New content for the section (patch) or text to append (append).

idempotency_key.description: Required for non-dry-run append. Reuse the same key only for an exact retry. Update and patch are set operations and may omit it.

tools.name: nitro_manage_billing
tools.description: Read billing/plans, create operator-approved subscription or add-funds checkout URLs, and poll status. This tool never pays; the operator opens the URL. Prepaid balance is separate from plans.

amount_cents.description: Integer amount in minor currency units

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this Add funds request

tools.name: nitro_send_message
tools.description: Send one transactional email/SMS now. Use nitro_compose_campaign for broadcasts and nitro_compose_flow for sequences. Reuse idempotency_key only for an exact retry.

to.description: Recipient email address or E.164 phone number

body.description: Message body. Required for SMS. Optional plain text for email.

template_id.description: Load email design from an existing template (email only)

data.description: Transactional merge variables. Use in email templates as {{ data.order_id }} or nested paths like {{ data.customer.name }}.

idempotency_key.description: Required for live sends. Reuse the same stable key on retry to prevent duplicate delivery.

tools.name: nitro_inbox
tools.description: Read the agent queue or mailbox. Follow exact next_calls for older or truncated thread content.

before_occurred_at.description: Exact ISO 8601 thread cursor returned by get_thread or get_thread_page

before_message_id.description: Exact thread cursor message id returned with before_occurred_at

offset.description: Exact sanitized-body character offset returned by get_thread or get_message_body

state.description: Optional queue state filter; default needs_attention

tools.name: nitro_inbox_action
tools.description: Mutate an agent inbox item or mailbox thread. Commands: send_reply, send_reply_test, mark_handled, request_human, release_to_agent, mark_quarantine.

action_item_id.description: Queue item id for queue-gated commands

conversation_id.description: Mailbox conversation id for reply commands

subject.description: Optional reply subject for send_reply or send_reply_test

body.description: Plain text reply body for send_reply or send_reply_test

html.description: Optional HTML reply body for send_reply or send_reply_test

reply_context_digest.description: Current reply_context.context_digest from nitro_inbox get_item/get_thread. Required for reply commands.

dry_run.description: Validate send_reply or send_reply_test without creating or sending

tools.name: nitro_request_support
tools.description: Submit support only when asked or tools cannot resolve the issue; never promote it. Send a complete message within 1500 characters; there is no truncation.

message.description: Complete, self-contained summary of the issue. Must fit within 1500 characters; do not rely on truncation.

tools.name: nitro_search_docs
tools.description: Search Nitrosend guides and API/MCP/CLI/integration references. Ground unestablished product claims in returned excerpts; search again or state what remains unverified.

query.description: What to look up, e.g. 'verify sending domain', 'rest api authentication', 'cli install', 'connect cursor'

resources.name: guide
resources.description: Reference guide for unfamiliar Nitrosend vocabulary and workflows. Covers Nitrosend entities (contacts, channels, flows, campaigns, templates, segments), the two operating modes (tool-driven and goal-driven), the recommended workflow sequence, volume and tier constraints, and common pitfalls.

resources.name: account
resources.description: Live snapshot of the current account context: account, brand, sender identity, dashboard links, tier (free / paid / trusted), email and SMS volume used vs caps, onboarding checklist progress, contact and list counts, and active flow/campaign summary.

resources.name: schema
resources.description: Machine-readable schema for composing emails and flows. Includes every email section type (header, text, image, button, columns, product, social, divider, spacer, footer) with required and optional props, all flow step types with their parameters, trigger event names, and the full list of segment filter names and predicates.

resources.name: brand-kit
resources.description: The selected brand's Brand Kit identity. Returns brand_color, text_color, bg_color, font_heading, font_body, logo_url, company_name, company_description, physical_address, screenshot_url when a website screenshot exists, and the brand voice document. For local logo files, use nitro_ingest with image_data or upload reservation before setting logo_url. Creative intent contracts already include the canonical authoring context; read this resource for manual edits or deeper inspection.

resources.name: providers
resources.description: Current email provider configuration and health. Shows whether the account uses Nitrosend's managed SES or a BYO provider (Mailgun, SES, Postmark, Resend, SendGrid), domain verification status for each sending domain, and the active sending mode (sandbox vs production).

resources.name: config
resources.description: Account-level sender defaults: from_name, from_email, reply_to, and saved test email recipients. These are applied automatically to campaigns and flows when per-message overrides are not specified.

resources.name: email-design
resources.description: Deep email design reference for campaign, template, or flow email sections. Composition contracts already include selected design capsules; read this only when deeper archetype, color, imagery, whitespace, footer, or section-translation context is needed.

resources.name: email-marketing
resources.description: Deep email marketing reference for campaign, template, or flow email content. Composition contracts already include selected marketing capsules; read this only when deeper strategy, audience, lifecycle, copy, deliverability, compliance, or intent context is needed.

resources.name: lifecycle
resources.description: Canonical machine-readable lifecycle flow catalog. Includes priority order, goal aliases, real trigger events, trigger gating requirements, revenue rationale, and structured cadence for welcome, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, win-back, re-engagement, and newsletter flows.

resources.name: docs
resources.description: The Nitrosend product documentation map: every guide, integration, CLI, concept, authentication, and REST API / MCP reference page with its path and summary. Use the nitro_search_docs tool to search the full documentation content for how-to and reference answers.

resources.name: example-email
resources.description: A complete working email design showing every section type in context — header with logo, hero image, text blocks, buttons, two-column product grid, social links, divider, spacer, and footer with unsubscribe. Use as a copy-paste starting point or reference for prop names, style overrides, and column nesting.

resources.name: example-flow
resources.description: A complete automation flow example demonstrating all step types: email with inline design, SMS, wait (duration in seconds), split with filter conditions and yes/no branches, emit_event, webhook, subscribe, and unsubscribe. Shows trigger configuration, branching structure, and merge-tag usage.

resources.name: example-campaign
resources.description: Complete campaign examples for both email and SMS channels. Shows audience targeting with contact_list_ids and segment_id, scheduled delivery with scheduled_at, inline email design with sections, and SMS body composition.

resources.name: knowledge-index
resources.description: Index of built-in email marketing knowledge topics. Returns a list of available slugs with titles and short descriptions. Use a slug with nitro://knowledge/{slug} to read the full topic content. Topics cover deliverability, subject lines, segmentation, automation best practices, and compliance.

resources.name: memory
resources.description: The operator's persistent AI memory document. Contains business goals, target audience, preferred email strategy, tone of voice notes, and any other context the operator has saved. Creative intent contracts already include the authoritative memory projection; read this resource for explicit inspection or memory management. Managed via the nitro_set_memory tool.

resources.name: history
resources.description: Unified account history combining notification events and MCP tool audit entries. Includes deliverability warnings, auto-pauses, suppressions, and tool-call audit records with timestamps, correlation IDs, payload summaries, and rollback eligibility.

resources.name: fields
resources.description: Per-account contact field catalog grouped by category (contact, custom, enrichment, engagement, tag). Each entry includes key, category, field_type, label, promoted flag, and fill_rate (percentage of contacts with a value, null when not yet computed). Read this for field and segment-filter inspection. The authoring intent's merge grammar is authoritative for recipient-copy bindings; field-catalog membership alone does not make an entry safe or portable email content.

resourceTemplates.name: authoring-context
resourceTemplates.description: Lossless paged read of the exact canonical brand authoring packet named by a composition contract. Start at its supplied ref URI, follow each exact next_uri, concatenate chunk.text in offset order, and verify packet_digest before filling that contract's draft call. A stale ref never returns current content under the old address.

resourceTemplates.name: outreach-campaign
resourceTemplates.description: Bounded discovery-campaign detail: target profile, criterion coverage, spend budgets, funnel counters, source progress, degradation, and activation-ready inventory. Use nitro_manage_outreach for intent, estimate, start, pause, resume, cancel, and summary status.

resourceTemplates.name: knowledge-topic
resourceTemplates.description: Full content for a single knowledge topic. Pass a slug from the knowledge index (e.g. nitro://knowledge/deliverability). Returns a markdown document with actionable guidance your AI can apply when composing emails, building flows, or advising on strategy.

resourceTemplates.name: prompt
resourceTemplates.description: Rendered prompt template by name. Returns structured workflow instructions that guide the AI through multi-step tasks like onboarding a new account, running a campaign review, or setting up a welcome series. Each prompt includes context requirements, step sequence, and expected tool calls.

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: What you want to learn or achieve, e.g. 'find disengaged subscribers', 'segment by purchase history', 'identify VIP customers'

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: What the email is for, e.g. 'announce our spring sale', 'weekly newsletter', 'event invitation', 'product launch'

prompts.name: build-flow
prompts.description: Create an automated email flow from scratch

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: What the flow should achieve, e.g. 'welcome series for new signups', 'abandoned cart recovery', 're-engage inactive subscribers'

prompts.name: diagnose-deliverability
prompts.description: Diagnose and fix email deliverability issues

prompts.name: flow-review
prompts.description: Review and optimise an existing flow

arguments.name: flow_id
arguments.description: ID of the flow to review. If omitted, lists active flows for the user to choose.

prompts.name: lifecycle-setup
prompts.description: Review a brand site and draft the key lifecycle automation flows

arguments.name: website_url
arguments.description: Brand website to review and scrape, e.g. https://example.com

arguments.name: test_recipient
arguments.description: Email address that should receive flow test messages

prompts.name: onboard-brand-kit
prompts.description: Set up Brand Kit identity for a new brand
